text: Toggle individual features on and off remotely without deploying new code
quote: Make changes remotely: Easily toggle individual features on and off, and make changes without deploying new code

text: Wrap code in a flag and toggle it per environment, user, or user segment
quote: Just wrap a section of code with a flag, and then use Flagsmith to toggle that feature on or off for different environments, users or user segments.

text: Define reusable segments of users by trait rules (location, plan, app version, usage) and override flags for everyone in a segment
quote: Define segments—groups of users matching rules based on traits (e.g., location, plan, app version, usage). Override feature flags for all users in a segment.

text: Gradually enable a feature for a percentage of users, globally or within a segment
quote: Gradually enable a feature for a percentage of users, either globally or within a segment.

text: Percentage split segment rule that includes a chosen 1-100% of the user base
quote: Add a rule defined with the % Split condition. Specify a value between 1 and 100 to define what percentage of your user base is included within this segment.

text: Override feature flags for individual users (identities) for internal testing, QA, support, or personalization
quote: Override feature flags for individual users ("identities"). Enables internal testing, QA, customer support, or personalised experiences at the user level.

text: Multivariate flags with multiple weighted variants for A/B/n splits
quote: Multivariate flags let you define multiple variants with percentage weightings (A/B/n).

text: Schedule flag changes to apply automatically at a specified future time
quote: Scheduled flags allow you to queue and automatically apply changes to feature flags at a specified future time, eliminating the need for manual intervention at the exact moment of change.

text: Release pipelines move flags through defined stages automatically, with triggers and actions controlling rollout to environments and audiences
quote: Define stages that your flags progress through automatically, with triggers and actions that control rollouts to selected environments and audiences.

text: Release pipelines can automatically generate change requests when promoting flags to production
quote: Release Pipelines can automatically generate change requests when promoting flags to production, eliminating manual effort and streamlining your deployment workflow.

text: Run end-to-end A/B tests on the platform: serve variants with multivariate flags and compare results
quote: Flagsmith Experimentation lets you run A/B tests end to end on the platform: serve variations of a feature with a multivariate flag, collect events from your application into a managed data warehouse, and read the results with a built-in Ba

text: Collect application events into a managed data warehouse for experiment analysis
quote: collect events from your application into a managed data warehouse, and read the results with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine.

text: Read experiment results with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine
quote: read the results with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine

text: Use segments to run A/B and multivariate tests on new features
quote: A/B testing: Use segments to run A/B and multivariate tests on new features

text: Release features to beta testers through segments, collect feedback, and iterate
quote: Segments: Release features to beta testers, collect feedback, and iterate

text: Every admin action is tracked in an audit log, so you can trace the history of flag, identity, and segment values
quote: Every action taken within the Flagsmith administration application is tracked and logged. This allows you to easily retrace the events and values that flags, identities and segments have taken over time.

text: Stream audit logs into your own infrastructure via audit log webhooks
quote: You can stream your Audit Logs into your own infrastructure using Audit Log Webhooks.

text: Change requests add a four-eyes create/approve/publish workflow for flag updates
quote: Feature Change Requests help creating a four-eyes workflow (create, approve, publish) to updating feature flags, similarly to Pull Requests in GitHub.

text: Role-based access control gives fine-grained access management over Flagsmith resources
quote: Role-based access control (RBAC) provides fine-grained access management of Flagsmith resources.

text: Restrict which users can modify production environments
quote: Only allow certain users to modify your production environments.

text: Self-host the complete Flagsmith platform on your own infrastructure for full control over data and deployment
quote: Self-hosting Flagsmith allows you to run the complete Flagsmith platform within your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your data, security policies, and deployment environment.

text: Run an entire Flagsmith environment locally with Docker
quote: You can use Docker to set up an entire Flagsmith Feature Flag environment locally

text: Deploy on Kubernetes and OpenShift with Helm charts and operators
quote: Kubernetes and OpenShift: Full Kubernetes deployment with Helm charts and operators

text: A self-hosted Edge Proxy runs the Flagsmith engine close to your servers, and server-side SDKs can connect to it
quote: Run the Edge Proxy within in your own infrastructure and connect to it from your server-side SDKs

text: Client-side flag API uses a public, non-secret environment key that is safe to expose in client code
quote: Authentication: Uses a public, non-secret Environment Key. Security: Open by design. The Environment Key can be exposed in client-side code.

text: Admin/Management API supports everything the dashboard does, including CRUD on projects, environments, flags, segments, and users
quote: This is the API you use to programmatically manage your Flagsmith projects. Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.

text: Official MCP server gives AI assistants and agents access to the Flagsmith Admin API
quote: The Flagsmith MCP Server gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to the Flagsmith Admin API through the Model Context Protocol

text: AI assistants can manage flags, segments, multivariate options, and release workflows through the MCP server
quote: Your assistant can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options, and release workflows on your behalf

text: Official CLI to manage flags, segments, projects, and environments from the terminal and evaluate flags as an SDK would
quote: The Flagsmith CLI lets you manage flags, segments, features, projects and environments from your terminal, and evaluate flags the way an SDK would.

text: SAML/SSO authentication
quote: SAML/SSO Authentication

text: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
quote: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)

text: Manage feature flags and remote config across web, mobile, and server-side apps
quote: Manage feature flags and remote config across web, mobile, and server-side apps.

text: SDKs for 15+ languages, including TypeScript, .NET, and Java, plus framework integrations such as React and Next.js
quote: SDKs & frameworks: Choose from 15+ popular languages like Typescript, .NET, Java, and more. Integrate with any framework, including React, Next.js, and more

text: Compatible with OpenFeature, which avoids vendor lock-in
quote: Thanks to our partnership with OpenFeature, you are never locked into one vendor.

text: Kill switch to quickly disable a feature for affected users when issues arise
quote: Quickly disable ("kill switch") a feature for affected users if issues arise.

text: Organize flags with tags, and mark them protected to prevent accidental deletion
quote: Tags (optional): organise your flags by tags or add `protected` to prevent them from accidentally being deleted.

text: Server-side-only setting stops a flag from being accessed by client-side SDKs
quote: **Server-side only**: enabling this prevents your flag from being accessed by client-side SDKs.

text: Unlimited feature flags and unlimited environments
quote: Unlimited Feature Flags ... Unlimited Environments
